200.description: The summary, streamed as plain text while the model writes it

Newline-delimited JSON events while the model works: {"tool": progress text}, {"text": answer text}, an {"error": message} if the AI stops mid-answer, and finally {"people": [{"id", "name"}]} for those mentioned.

delete.description: An owner removes someone, or a member leaves.

post.description: Proposes people and connections from a note. Saves nothing.
Saves a reviewed proposal in one go: new people, notes on matched ones, connections.

is_me.description: Whether the current user marked this person "This is me"
is_me.title: Is Me

pending.description: People not yet indexed with their latest details
pending.title: Pending

PersonConnectionOut.description: A connection seen from one person's page.
PersonConnectionOut.title: PersonConnectionOut

Proposal.description:
People (new, or matched to someone in the tree) and connections between them, by ref.
Returned by /extract for review, and sent back, edited, to /extract/apply.
Proposal.title: Proposal
